note: Defaults for the policy layer (PLAN WS-M.3). A member's own preferences override these; urgent ignores consent, caps, quiet hours and mute.

questions.note: Repetition rules for question_due (references/proactive.md 一·提问). A recurring question whose last answers agree waits interval_days × backoff_factor^(same answers in a row − 1), at most max_interval_days. A question asked retire_after_ignored times in a row without an answer is not asked again until the member answers it in chat (an answer action with params.question). An unanswered ask is retried after unanswered_retry_days.
